In order to increase the activity in the brazilian QuakeWorld community, '''QuakeWorld BR 2on2''' is the first tournament in the region for a very long time. Kicking off with [[2on2]], there's intentions of hosting other modes in the future. Signups closed March 26th, and the tournament started the day after.

=== Format ===
* '''Round-Robin Group''' 
** 12 teams, top 4 advance to Playoffs
** All games are {{Abbr|BO5|Best of Five}}
* '''Single-Elimination Bracket'''
** All games are {{Abbr|BO5|Best of Five}}

=== Prize pool ===
The registration fee of 50 {{abbr|reais|Brazilian real}} will go 100% into the prize pool. Donations are welcome.
